papers.title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
papers.what: Reformulates the fixed-size recurrent memory of linear attention as a linear-Gaussian state-space model and uses the Kalman filter as the write rule, so each write is weighted by tracked uncertainty rather than by the current token alone, with diagonal and isotropic approximations that keep the associative scan and improve perplexity and downstream accuracy at 750M and 1.3B parameters.
papers.builds_on: Mamba-2 (2024, JPKDWV2Q); HiPPO (2020, 5YQ4IKMA); Attention Is All You Need (2017, PHB9VRVM)

papers.title: Memory in Deep Time-Series Models
papers.what: Re-reads recurrent networks, transformers, state-space models, retrieval-augmented predictors, foundation models and time-series agents as successive answers to one question about what a model retains beyond its input window, and organizes them on an internal-to-external memory spectrum with a shared account of what is written, how it is read, and how it persists.
papers.builds_on: TS-Agent (2025, I2CIT4I7); LLMs for TS Survey (2024, N2JLZBY3); Memory Mechanisms Survey (2026, BDY3HUCV)

papers.title: Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation
papers.what: Lets a stronger student inherit a weaker teacher's post-training gains without inheriting its ceiling, by measuring the teacher's policy shift on the student's own rollouts and amplifying only the verifier-supported component of the student's gradient along that direction, which preserves the student's stationary points while reaching final performance in fewer updates.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); PPO (2017, KQTIJC4U); Policy Gradient (1999, DAGWCZ67)

papers.title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
papers.what: Turns serving traffic into training data by logging the router's capability prediction and the full harness context of each agent turn, then using those routing signals to organize a three-stage curriculum and on-policy distillation, raising the eleven-benchmark macro-average from 58.94 to 64.87 at 4B and 65.60 to 69.04 at 9B.
